theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  have hx : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    have h₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have h₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    simp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap, h₁, h₀, Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue,
      one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    have hq := congrArg Subtype.val h
    dsimp only at hq
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←hq, P₀, P₁]
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
      rw [h_eval 0, h_eval 1, hx]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
        Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
